summary.zh: 朱元璋称帝，国号大明，定都应天。
summary.en: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaimed the Ming dynasty with its capital at Yingtian.

description.zh: 1368 年，朱元璋在应天称帝，国号大明，年号洪武，随后北伐推翻元朝。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1368, Zhu Yuanzhang proclaimed himself emperor at Yingtian, founded the Ming, and adopted the Hongwu era name. His northern campaign soon ended Yuan rule in China. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 燕王朱棣起兵攻入南京，建文帝失踪，朱棣即位。
summary.en: Prince Zhu Di seized Nanjing, and the Jianwen Emperor disappeared.

description.zh: 1399 年燕王朱棣以“靖难”为名起兵，1402 年攻入南京，建文帝失踪，朱棣即位，是为明成祖。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1399 Prince Zhu Di rose in the name of “pacifying the troubles.” In 1402 he entered Nanjing; the Jianwen Emperor disappeared, and Zhu Di took the throne as the Yongle Emperor. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 明成祖迁都北京，南京改为留都。
summary.en: The Yongle Emperor moved the capital to Beijing, leaving Nanjing as the secondary capital.

description.zh: 1421 年，明成祖正式迁都北京，以南京为留都，北京成为明朝政治中心。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1421 the Yongle Emperor formally moved the capital to Beijing and made Nanjing the auxiliary capital, establishing Beijing as the political center of the Ming. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 明英宗亲征瓦剌，在土木堡兵败被俘。
summary.en: Emperor Yingzong campaigned against the Oirats and was captured at Tumu.

description.zh: 1449 年，明英宗在宦官王振怂恿下亲征瓦剌，明军在土木堡被也先击败，英宗被俘，史称土木堡之变。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1449, urged by the eunuch Wang Zhen, Emperor Yingzong personally campaigned against the Oirats. The Ming army was defeated at Tumu by Esen, and the emperor was captured. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: Wang Yangming suppresses the Prince of Ning

summary.zh: 宁王朱宸濠起兵，王阳明三十余日平定。
summary.en: Prince of Ning rose in rebellion and Wang Yangming suppressed him in about a month.

description.zh: 1519 年，宁王朱宸濠在南昌起兵反明，王阳明调集兵力，三十余日平定，朱宸濠被俘。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1519 Prince of Ning Zhu Chenhao rose against the Ming in Nanchang. Wang Yangming rallied forces and suppressed the rebellion in about a month, capturing the prince. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 俺答汗率军逼近北京，明廷戒严。
summary.en: Altan Khan’s forces approached Beijing and the Ming court imposed martial law.

description.zh: 1550 年，俺答汗率蒙古军队逼近北京，明廷戒严，史称庚戌之变，暴露了明朝北部防务的虚弱。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1550 Altan Khan led Mongol forces close to Beijing, prompting martial law and revealing the weakness of Ming northern defenses; the episode is known as the Gengxu crisis. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 戚继光率戚家军在台州九战九捷。
summary.en: Qi Jiguang’s army won nine victories at Taizhou.

description.zh: 1561 年，戚继光率戚家军在台州九战九捷，重创倭寇，戚家军由此声名大振。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1561 Qi Jiguang’s army won nine successive victories at Taizhou, badly damaging the wokou pirates and earning the Qi army great renown. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 戚继光攻破横屿倭巢。
summary.en: Qi Jiguang destroyed the pirate base at Hengyu.

description.zh: 1562 年，戚继光率军攻破福建宁德横屿倭巢，收复被倭寇盘踞的岛屿，为平定福建倭患奠定基础。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1562 Qi Jiguang’s forces destroyed the wokou base at Hengyu in Ningde, Fujian, recovering the island and paving the way for pacifying Fujian’s pirate troubles. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 明廷封俺答为顺义王，开放互市。
summary.en: The Ming court recognized Altan Khan and opened border markets.

description.zh: 1571 年，明廷与蒙古俺答汗达成和议，封俺答为顺义王，开放大同、宣府等地互市，史称隆庆和议。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1571 the Ming court reached a peace with Altan Khan, recognized him as Prince Shunyi, and opened markets at Datong, Xuanfu, and other border towns. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 张居正任首辅，推行考成法与一条鞭法。
summary.en: Zhang Juzheng became chief grand secretary and pushed reforms.

description.zh: 1572 年，张居正任首辅，推行考成法、一条鞭法等改革，整顿吏治与财政，万历初年出现中兴局面。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1572 Zhang Juzheng became chief grand secretary and promoted reforms including the examination-of-achievements system and the single-whip tax method, tightening administration and finances and producing a brief revival in the early Wanli reign. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 明军平定宁夏哱拜叛乱。
summary.en: Ming forces suppressed the rebellion of Bobai in Ningxia.

description.zh: 1592 年，宁夏哱拜叛乱，明军围攻银川并最终平定，为万历三大征之一。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1592 Bobai rebelled in Ningxia. Ming forces besieged Yinchuan and eventually suppressed the revolt, one of the three great campaigns of the Wanli reign. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日本入侵朝鲜，明廷派军援朝。
summary.en: Japan invaded Korea and the Ming sent forces to aid Korea.

description.zh: 1592 年，日本丰臣秀吉入侵朝鲜，明廷派军援朝，战争持续至 1598 年，史称万历朝鲜战争（壬辰倭乱）。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1592 Toyotomi Hideyoshi’s Japan invaded Korea. The Ming sent forces to aid Korea, and the war continued until 1598, known as the Imjin War. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李如松率明军收复平壤。
summary.en: Li Rusong’s Ming army recaptured Pyongyang.

description.zh: 1593 年，李如松率明军收复平壤，击败日军，扭转了朝鲜战场的局势。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1593 Li Rusong’s Ming army recaptured Pyongyang and defeated Japanese forces, turning the tide in Korea. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中朝联军在露梁海域击败日军。
summary.en: Ming and Korean fleets defeated the Japanese at Noryang.

description.zh: 1598 年，中朝联军在露梁海域截击撤退的日军，重创日本水师，明将邓子龙与朝鲜李舜臣战死，战争随之结束。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1598 the Ming and Korean fleets intercepted retreating Japanese forces at Noryang, badly damaging the Japanese navy. Ming general Deng Zilong and Korean admiral Yi Sun-sin died in the battle, which ended the war. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 明军平定播州杨应龙。
summary.en: Ming forces suppressed Yang Yinglong of Bozhou.

description.zh: 1600 年，明军平定播州杨应龙，攻破海龙屯，为万历三大征之一。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1600 Ming forces suppressed Yang Yinglong of Bozhou and captured Hailong Fort, one of the three great campaigns of the Wanli reign. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The revival of the Donglin Academy

summary.zh: 顾宪成等重建无锡东林书院。
summary.en: Gu Xiancheng and others revived the Donglin Academy in Wuxi.

description.zh: 1604 年，顾宪成等重建无锡东林书院，讲学议政，形成东林党，成为晚明政治的重要力量。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1604 Gu Xiancheng and others revived the Donglin Academy in Wuxi, where scholars lectured and discussed politics, forming the Donglin faction and becoming a major force in late Ming politics. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 努尔哈赤建立后金，建元天命。
summary.en: Nurhaci founded the Later Jin and adopted the Tianming era name.

description.zh: 1616 年，建州女真首领努尔哈赤在赫图阿拉建立后金，建元天命，为清朝前身。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1616 the Jianzhou Jurchen leader Nurhaci founded the Later Jin at Hetu Ala and adopted the Tianming era name, a predecessor of the Qing. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 后金集中兵力击败明军四路进攻。
summary.en: The Later Jin concentrated its forces and defeated the four-pronged Ming advance.

description.zh: 1619 年，明军分四路进攻后金，努尔哈赤集中兵力各个击破，明军大败，史称萨尔浒之战。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1619 the Ming launched a four-pronged attack on the Later Jin. Nurhaci concentrated his forces and defeated each column in turn, a decisive victory known as the Battle of Sarhu. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 李自成攻入北京，崇祯帝自缢，明朝灭亡。
summary.en: Li Zicheng took Beijing; the Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself, ending the Ming.

description.zh: 1644 年 4 月，李自成率大顺军攻入北京，崇祯帝在煤山自缢，明朝灭亡，随后清军入关。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In April 1644 Li Zicheng’s Dashun army entered Beijing. The Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself on Coal Hill, ending the Ming dynasty, and Qing forces soon entered China proper. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 吴三桂降清，清军入关，定都北京。
summary.en: Wu Sangui submitted to the Qing, whose forces entered China and made Beijing their capital.

description.zh: 1644 年，李自成攻入北京，崇祯帝自缢；吴三桂引清军入关，清军击败李自成，随后定都北京。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1644 Li Zicheng captured Beijing and the Chongzhen Emperor took his own life. Wu Sangui opened the pass to Qing forces, which defeated Li Zicheng and soon made Beijing their capital. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 福王朱由崧在南京即位，建立弘光政权。
summary.en: Prince Fu ascended the throne in Nanjing, founding the Hongguang regime.

description.zh: 1644 年 6 月，福王朱由崧在南京即位，改元弘光，南明第一个政权建立，仍控制江南部分地区。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In June 1644 Prince Fu of Zhu ascended the throne in Nanjing and adopted the era name Hongguang, founding the first Southern Ming regime, which still controlled parts of Jiangnan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 清军攻破扬州，史可法殉国，随后屠城。
summary.en: Qing forces took Yangzhou, Shi Kefa died, and the city was massacred.

description.zh: 1645 年 4 月，清军攻破扬州，史可法殉国，随后清军在城中进行大规模屠杀，史称扬州十日。具体死亡人数为通行说法，本文只记事件性质。日期与经过待页码级核对。
description.en: In April 1645 Qing forces breached Yangzhou and Shi Kefa died; the city was then subjected to a large-scale massacre, known as the Ten Days of Yangzhou. Casualty figures follow conventional accounts; this entry records only the nature of the event. Dates and details await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 嘉定民众抗清，清军三次屠城。
summary.en: Jiading resisted Qing rule and was massacred three times.

description.zh: 1645 年夏秋，嘉定民众抗清，清军三次攻破嘉定并屠城，史称嘉定三屠。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the summer and autumn of 1645 Jiading’s residents resisted Qing rule; Qing forces breached the town three times and carried out massacres, known as the Three Massacres of Jiading. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 江阴民众抗清八十一日，城破遭屠。
summary.en: Jiangyin resisted for eighty-one days before the city fell and was massacred.

description.zh: 1645 年，江阴民众在阎应元等率领下抗清八十一日，城破后遭屠。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1645 Jiangyin’s residents, led by figures such as Yan Yingyuan, resisted Qing forces for eighty-one days before the city fell and was massacred. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 唐王朱聿键在福州称帝，建立隆武政权。
summary.en: Prince Tang proclaimed himself emperor in Fuzhou, founding the Longwu regime.

description.zh: 1645 年 8 月，唐王朱聿键在福州称帝，改元隆武，继续抗清，倚重郑芝龙、黄道周等人。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1645 Prince Tang proclaimed himself emperor in Fuzhou with the era name Longwu and continued resistance to the Qing, relying on figures such as Zheng Zhilong and Huang Daozhou. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 桂王朱由榔在肇庆即位，建立永历政权。
summary.en: Prince Gui ascended the throne in Zhaoqing, founding the Yongli regime.

description.zh: 1646 年 12 月，桂王朱由榔在肇庆即位，改元永历，成为南明存续最久、辗转西南的政权。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In December 1646 Prince Gui ascended the throne in Zhaoqing with the era name Yongli, becoming the longest-lasting Southern Ming regime, based in the southwest. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 李定国攻桂林，清定南王孔有德自尽。
summary.en: Li Dingguo took Guilin; Kong Youde took his own life.

description.zh: 1652 年 7 月，李定国率大西军余部攻桂林，清定南王孔有德兵败自尽，南明抗清声势大振。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In July 1652 Li Dingguo led the remnants of the Daxi army against Guilin. Qing Prince Kong Youde was defeated and took his own life, greatly boosting Southern Ming resistance. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 李定国在衡州设伏，清亲王尼堪战死。
summary.en: Li Dingguo ambushed Qing forces at Hengzhou, killing Prince Nikan.

description.zh: 1652 年 11 月，李定国在衡州设伏，清敬谨亲王尼堪战死，南明抗清声势达到高峰。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1652 Li Dingguo ambushed Qing forces at Hengzhou and killed Prince Nikan, bringing Southern Ming resistance to its height. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 郑成功率军北伐，围攻南京失利。
summary.en: Zheng Chenggong’s northern expedition besieged Nanjing but failed.

description.zh: 1659 年，郑成功率军北伐，围攻南京，因轻敌与补给不继失利，退回厦门，北伐就此结束。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1659 Zheng Chenggong led a northern expedition and besieged Nanjing. Overconfidence and supply problems led to defeat, and he withdrew to Xiamen, ending the campaign. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The coastal evacuation and sea ban

summary.zh: 清廷下令东南沿海迁界禁海。
summary.en: The Qing ordered coastal evacuation and a maritime ban.

description.zh: 1661 年，清廷为切断郑氏补给，下令东南沿海迁界禁海，居民内迁，沿海经济受到重创。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1661 the Qing court ordered coastal evacuation and a maritime ban to cut off Zheng Chenggong’s supplies. Residents were moved inland and the coastal economy suffered heavily. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 郑成功渡海攻台，荷兰殖民者投降。
summary.en: Zheng Chenggong crossed the sea, besieged the Dutch, and recovered Taiwan.

description.zh: 1661 年郑成功率军自厦门渡海进攻台湾，围攻热兰遮城；1662 年荷兰殖民者投降，郑氏收复台湾。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1661 Zheng Chenggong led his forces from Xiamen across the sea to Taiwan and besieged Fort Zeelandia. In 1662 the Dutch surrendered, and the Zheng regime took control of Taiwan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The capture of the Yongli Emperor

summary.zh: 吴三桂在昆明缢杀永历帝，南明终结。
summary.en: Wu Sangui executed the Yongli Emperor in Kunming, ending the Southern Ming.

description.zh: 1662 年 6 月，吴三桂在昆明缢杀永历帝，南明政权终结，西南抗清力量随之瓦解。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In June 1662 Wu Sangui had the Yongli Emperor strangled in Kunming, ending the Southern Ming and causing the collapse of resistance in the southwest. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 郑成功去世后，郑经在厦门嗣位。
summary.en: After Zheng Chenggong’s death, Zheng Jing succeeded him in Xiamen.

description.zh: 1662 年 6 月，郑成功去世后，郑经在厦门嗣位，与叔父郑袭争位，最终控制台湾与沿海据点。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In June 1662, after Zheng Chenggong’s death, Zheng Jing succeeded him in Xiamen. He contested power with his uncle Zheng Xi and eventually controlled Taiwan and coastal strongholds. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 李定国在勐腊病逝。
summary.en: Li Dingguo died of illness at Mengla.

description.zh: 1662 年 8 月，李定国在勐腊病逝，临终嘱部众勿降清，南明在西南的抵抗基本结束。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1662 Li Dingguo died of illness at Mengla, telling his followers not to surrender to the Qing. Southern Ming resistance in the southwest effectively ended. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 张煌言在杭州就义。
summary.en: Zhang Huangyan was executed in Hangzhou.

description.zh: 1664 年 10 月，张煌言在杭州就义，南明抗清力量基本瓦解，仅余台湾郑氏。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1664 Zhang Huangyan was executed in Hangzhou. Southern Ming resistance largely collapsed, leaving only the Zheng regime in Taiwan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

name.en: The Revolt of the Three Feudatories

summary.zh: 吴三桂在云南起兵，三藩之乱爆发。
summary.en: Wu Sangui rose in Yunnan, beginning the Revolt of the Three Feudatories.

description.zh: 1673 年，平西王吴三桂在云南起兵反清，耿精忠、尚之信等响应，三藩之乱爆发，至 1681 年才被平定。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1673 Wu Sangui, Prince of Pingxi, rose against the Qing in Yunnan; Geng Jingzhong and Shang Zhixin soon joined, beginning the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, which was suppressed only in 1681. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 三藩之乱爆发后，郑经反攻福建。
summary.en: After the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, Zheng Jing attacked Fujian.

description.zh: 1674 年，三藩之乱爆发后，郑经率军反攻福建，一度占领泉州、漳州等地，后与耿精忠冲突，最终退回厦门。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1674, after the Revolt of the Three Feudatories broke out, Zheng Jing led forces into Fujian and briefly took Quanzhou and Zhangzhou. After clashes with Geng Jingzhong he withdrew to Xiamen. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 施琅率水师攻台，郑克塽降清。
summary.en: Shi Lang’s fleet attacked Taiwan, and Zheng Keshuang surrendered.

description.zh: 1683 年，福建水师提督施琅率军攻台，在澎湖击败郑军，郑克塽投降，清朝统一台湾。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1683 Admiral Shi Lang led the Fujian fleet against Taiwan, defeated the Zheng forces at Penghu, and accepted Zheng Keshuang’s surrender, bringing Taiwan under Qing rule. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 施琅率清军水师在澎湖击败刘国轩。
summary.en: Shi Lang’s fleet defeated Liu Guoxuan at Penghu.

description.zh: 1683 年 7 月，施琅率清军水师在澎湖击败刘国轩，郑军主力受挫，为清廷统一台湾奠定基础。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In July 1683 Shi Lang’s Qing fleet defeated Liu Guoxuan at Penghu, crippling the Zheng navy and paving the way for the Qing conquest of Taiwan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 郑克塽在承天府降清，明郑结束。
summary.en: Zheng Keshuang surrendered at Chengtian Prefecture, ending the Zheng regime.

description.zh: 1683 年 10 月，郑克塽在承天府降清，明郑政权结束，台湾纳入清朝版图。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1683 Zheng Keshuang surrendered at Chengtian Prefecture, ending the Zheng regime and bringing Taiwan under Qing rule. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 明郑与台湾地方史参考

summary.zh: 清军围攻雅克萨，俄军投降。
summary.en: Qing forces besieged Albazin and forced the Russian garrison to surrender.

description.zh: 1685 年，清军围攻雅克萨，俄军投降；俄军随后重占，1686 年清军再次围攻，最终促成尼布楚谈判。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1685 Qing forces besieged Albazin and forced the Russian garrison to surrender. The Russians later reoccupied it, leading to a second siege in 1686 and eventually the Nerchinsk negotiations. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 中俄签订尼布楚条约，划定东段边界。
summary.en: Qing China and Russia signed the Treaty of Nerchinsk, fixing their eastern border.

description.zh: 1689 年，清朝与沙俄在尼布楚签订条约，划定两国东段边界，是清朝与欧洲国家签订的第一个正式边界条约。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1689 Qing China and Russia signed the Treaty of Nerchinsk, fixing their eastern border. It was the first formal boundary treaty between the Qing and a European power. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 清军在乌兰布通与噶尔丹激战。
summary.en: Qing forces fought Galdan at Ulan Butung.

description.zh: 1690 年，清军在乌兰布通与噶尔丹激战，噶尔丹败退，清廷由此加强对漠北的经营。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1690 Qing forces fought a fierce battle with Galdan at Ulan Butung. Galdan withdrew, and the Qing strengthened its engagement in Mongolia. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 康熙与喀尔喀蒙古各部在多伦会盟。
summary.en: The Kangxi Emperor met Khalkha Mongol leaders at Dolon.

description.zh: 1691 年，康熙帝与喀尔喀蒙古各部在多伦会盟，确立对喀尔喀的管辖，强化北部边疆秩序。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1691 the Kangxi Emperor and Khalkha Mongol leaders held a congress at Dolon, establishing Qing authority over the Khalkha and strengthening the northern frontier. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清军在昭莫多大败噶尔丹。
summary.en: Qing forces decisively defeated Galdan at Jao Modo.

description.zh: 1696 年，清军在昭莫多大败噶尔丹，噶尔丹势力瓦解，清廷对漠北的控制进一步加强。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1696 Qing forces decisively defeated Galdan at Jao Modo. His power collapsed, and Qing control over Mongolia was further consolidated. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 康熙宣布滋生人丁永不加赋，为摊丁入亩奠基。
summary.en: The Kangxi Emperor froze the head tax, paving the way for tax reform.

description.zh: 1712 年，康熙宣布“滋生人丁永不加赋”，其后雍正推行摊丁入亩，将丁银摊入田赋，赋税制度发生重大变化。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1712 the Kangxi Emperor declared that additional population would not increase the head tax. Under the Yongzheng Emperor the head tax was merged into the land tax, a major change in taxation. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 康熙帝去世，胤禛即位，是为雍正帝。
summary.en: The Kangxi Emperor died and Yinzhen ascended as the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh: 1722 年，康熙帝去世，皇四子胤禛即位，次年改元雍正；其即位过程与遗诏真伪长期存在争议。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1722 the Kangxi Emperor died and his fourth son Yinzhen ascended the throne, adopting the Yongzheng era name the following year. The succession and the authenticity of the edict have long been debated. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 雍正帝在西南推行改土归流。
summary.en: The Yongzheng Emperor replaced native chieftains with appointed officials in the southwest.

description.zh: 1726 年起，雍正帝在西南推行改土归流，废除土司，改设流官，加强对云南、贵州、广西等地的直接治理。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 1726 the Yongzheng Emperor promoted the replacement of native chieftains with appointed officials in the southwest, abolishing hereditary tusi and strengthening direct governance in Yunnan, Guizhou, and Guangxi. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 雍正设军机处，强化皇权与政务效率。
summary.en: The Yongzheng Emperor established the Grand Council to centralize decision-making.

description.zh: 1729 年，雍正帝因西北用兵设立军机处，后成为清朝最高决策机构，强化了皇权与政务效率。日期与制度为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1729, during the northwestern campaigns, the Yongzheng Emperor established the Grand Council, which became the Qing’s highest decision-making body and strengthened imperial control. Dates and institutions follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 乾隆两次用兵金川，至 1776 年平定。
summary.en: The Qianlong Emperor campaigned twice in Jinchuan, pacifying it by 1776.

description.zh: 1747 年起，乾隆帝两次对大小金川用兵，至 1776 年最终平定，是乾隆“十全武功”中耗时最长、耗费最大的一役。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 1747 the Qianlong Emperor launched two campaigns against the Jinchuan chiefdoms, finally pacifying them in 1776. It was the longest and most costly of the “Ten Great Campaigns.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The Qing conquest of the Dzungars

summary.zh: 清军攻灭准噶尔汗国，控制新疆。
summary.en: Qing forces destroyed the Dzungar Khanate and took control of Xinjiang.

description.zh: 1755 年，清军分路进攻准噶尔，攻占伊犁，准噶尔汗国灭亡，清朝随后控制天山南北。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1755 Qing forces advanced on the Dzungars from several routes, captured Ili, and destroyed the Dzungar Khanate, bringing the Tian Shan region under Qing control. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 清廷限定广州一口对外通商。
summary.en: The Qing restricted foreign trade to Canton alone.

description.zh: 1757 年，清廷限定广州一口对外通商，由十三行垄断贸易，闭关政策进一步强化，直至鸦片战争后被打破。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1757 the Qing restricted foreign trade to Canton, with the Thirteen Factories monopolizing commerce. The closed-door policy hardened until it was broken after the Opium War. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清军平定大小和卓，控制新疆。
summary.en: Qing forces defeated the Khoja brothers and consolidated control of Xinjiang.

description.zh: 1759 年，清军平定大小和卓叛乱，控制天山南路，与 1755 年平定准噶尔一起构成乾隆“十全武功”的重要部分。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1759 Qing forces suppressed the Khoja brothers’ rebellion and consolidated control of the southern Tian Shan, completing the conquest of Xinjiang alongside the 1755 campaign against the Dzungars. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The Complete Library of the Four Treasuries

summary.zh: 清廷开馆编纂《四库全书》。
summary.en: The Qing court began compiling the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries.

description.zh: 1773 年，清廷开馆编纂《四库全书》，汇集历代典籍，同时大量禁毁“违碍”书籍，成为清代文化控制与文献整理的双重象征。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1773 the Qing court began compiling the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries, gathering texts from across history while also banning and destroying many works deemed objectionable—a dual symbol of literary compilation and cultural control. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Qing campaign against the Gurkhas

summary.zh: 福康安率军入藏，击退廓尔喀。
summary.en: Fu Kang’an led Qing forces into Tibet and repelled the Gurkhas.

description.zh: 1792 年，廓尔喀入侵西藏，福康安率清军入藏反击，收复失地并逼近廓尔喀，随后订立《钦定藏内善后章程》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1792 the Gurkhas invaded Tibet. Fu Kang’an led Qing forces into Tibet, recovered the lost territory, and advanced toward Nepal, leading to the Qing regulations for Tibet. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 英国使团觐见乾隆，通商请求被拒。
summary.en: The British Macartney embassy met the Qianlong Emperor, but its trade requests were refused.

description.zh: 1793 年，英国马戛尔尼使团在承德觐见乾隆帝，提出通商、设馆等请求，被清廷拒绝，成为中西外交观念冲突的典型案例。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1793 the British Macartney embassy met the Qianlong Emperor at Chengde and requested trade and residence rights, which the Qing court refused, a classic case of conflicting diplomatic assumptions. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 白莲教在湖北起事，波及川楚陕。
summary.en: The White Lotus uprising began in Hubei and spread across Sichuan, Hubei, and Shaanxi.

description.zh: 1796 年，白莲教在湖北襄阳等地起事，迅速波及四川、湖北、陕西，清廷调集重兵镇压，至 1804 年才基本平定。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1796 the White Lotus movement rose in Xiangyang and other parts of Hubei, spreading quickly into Sichuan and Shaanxi. The Qing deployed large forces and suppressed the rebellion only around 1804. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 天理教攻入紫禁城，失败。
summary.en: The Eight Trigrams sect attacked the Forbidden City but was defeated.

description.zh: 1813 年，天理教（八卦教）在林清等率领下攻入紫禁城，与清军激战失败，史称癸酉之变。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1813 the Eight Trigrams sect, led by Lin Qing and others, attacked the Forbidden City. After fierce fighting the uprising failed, an event known as the Guiyou incident. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The destruction of opium at Humen

summary.zh: 林则徐在虎门销毁鸦片。
summary.en: Lin Zexu destroyed confiscated opium at Humen.

description.zh: 1839 年 6 月，钦差大臣林则徐在广东虎门海滩当众销毁收缴的鸦片，成为鸦片战争的直接导火索之一。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In June 1839 Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu publicly destroyed confiscated opium at Humen, an event that helped trigger the First Opium War. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 英国舰队封锁珠江口，鸦片战争爆发。
summary.en: The British fleet blockaded the Pearl River estuary, beginning the First Opium War.

description.zh: 1840 年，英国以禁烟为借口派舰队封锁珠江口，进攻虎门，鸦片战争爆发，清朝战败后签订《南京条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1840 Britain used the opium crackdown as a pretext to blockade the Pearl River estuary and attack Humen, beginning the First Opium War. After defeat the Qing signed the Treaty of Nanjing. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 洪秀全在金田起义，建太平天国。
summary.en: Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian and founded the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

description.zh: 1851 年，洪秀全在广西金田起义，建号太平天国，随后攻占南京，成为清朝规模最大的内部战争。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1851 Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian in Guangxi and founded the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. The movement later captured Nanjing and became the largest internal war of the Qing period. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 总理衙门设立，洋务运动兴起。
summary.en: The Zongli Yamen was established, launching the Self-Strengthening Movement.

description.zh: 1861 年，清廷设立总理各国事务衙门，随后创办近代军工、民用企业与新式学堂，史称洋务运动，试图“师夷长技以自强”。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1861 the Qing established the Zongli Yamen (Foreign Office), followed by modern arsenals, enterprises, and schools. The Self-Strengthening Movement sought to adopt Western technology while preserving Qing rule. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 清廷设立京师同文馆，培养外语与洋务人才。
summary.en: The Qing founded the Tongwen Guan in Beijing to train foreign-language and technical talent.

description.zh: 1862 年，清廷设立京师同文馆，最初培养外语翻译人才，后增设算学、格致等课程，是洋务教育的重要起点。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1862 the Qing established the Tongwen Guan in Beijing, initially to train translators and later adding mathematics and science, a key starting point for modern education in the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李鸿章奏设上海广方言馆，培养外语人才。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the Shanghai Foreign Language School to train interpreters.

description.zh: 1863 年，李鸿章在上海奏设广方言馆，招收学生研习外语与西学，后并入江南制造总局翻译馆，是洋务教育的重要机构。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1863 Li Hongzhang founded the Shanghai Foreign Language School to teach foreign languages and Western learning. It later merged with the Jiangnan Arsenal’s translation department and became an important institution of Self-Strengthening education. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 李鸿章创办江南制造总局。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the Jiangnan Arsenal in Shanghai.

description.zh: 1865 年，李鸿章在上海创办江南制造总局，制造枪炮、弹药与轮船，是洋务运动最重要的军工企业之一。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1865 Li Hongzhang founded the Jiangnan Arsenal in Shanghai to produce firearms, ammunition, and ships. It became one of the most important military enterprises of the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 左宗棠创办福州船政局。
summary.en: Zuo Zongtang founded the Fuzhou Navy Yard.

description.zh: 1866 年，左宗棠在福州马尾创办福州船政局，附设船政学堂，培养海军与造船人才，是洋务运动的重要海军基地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1866 Zuo Zongtang founded the Fuzhou Navy Yard at Mawei, with a naval school attached. It trained naval officers and shipbuilders and became a key base of the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 福州船政学堂开学，培养海军与造船人才。
summary.en: The Fuzhou Naval School opened to train naval officers and shipbuilders.

description.zh: 1867 年，福州船政学堂（求是堂艺局）在马尾开学，分前学堂与后学堂，分别培养造船与驾驶人才，被誉为中国近代海军的摇篮。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1867 the Fuzhou Naval School opened at Mawei with separate departments for shipbuilding and navigation, earning a reputation as the cradle of China’s modern navy. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 清廷派遣首批幼童赴美留学。
summary.en: The Qing sent the first group of young students to study in the United States.

description.zh: 1872 年，在容闳推动下，清廷派遣首批幼童赴美留学，至 1875 年共派出四批，后因保守派反对于 1881 年撤回。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1872, promoted by Yung Wing, the Qing sent the first group of young students to the United States; four batches followed by 1875, but the mission was recalled in 1881 amid conservative opposition. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company

summary.zh: 李鸿章创办轮船招商局。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company.

description.zh: 1872 年，李鸿章在上海创办轮船招商局，经营江海航运，与外国轮船公司竞争，是洋务运动“官督商办”的代表企业。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1872 Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company in Shanghai to operate river and coastal shipping in competition with foreign firms, a representative “official supervision and merchant management” enterprise. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 左宗棠率军收复新疆，除伊犁外全境平定。
summary.en: Zuo Zongtang recovered Xinjiang, pacifying the region except for Ili.

description.zh: 1876—1878 年，左宗棠率清军西征，先后收复北疆与南疆，除沙俄占据的伊犁外，新疆重归清朝控制。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 1876 to 1878 Zuo Zongtang led Qing forces westward, recovering northern and southern Xinjiang. Except for Ili, held by Russia, the region returned to Qing control. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李鸿章创办开平矿务局，开采煤矿。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the Kaiping Mines to exploit coal deposits.

description.zh: 1878 年，李鸿章创办开平矿务局，采用机器开采煤矿，为轮船、军工与铁路提供燃料，是洋务民用企业的重要代表。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1878 Li Hongzhang founded the Kaiping Mines, using modern machinery to extract coal for steamships, arsenals, and railways, a major civilian enterprise of the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李鸿章创办天津水师学堂。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the Tianjin Naval Academy.

description.zh: 1880 年，李鸿章在天津创办水师学堂，由严复任总教习，培养北洋海军军官，是继福州船政学堂之后又一座海军学校。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1880 Li Hongzhang founded the Tianjin Naval Academy, with Yan Fu as chief instructor, to train officers for the Beiyang Navy. It was the second major naval school after Fuzhou. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 法国舰队袭击马尾，福建水师覆没。
summary.en: The French fleet attacked Mawei and destroyed the Fujian fleet.

description.zh: 1884 年，中法战争爆发，法国舰队在马尾袭击福建水师，福建水师几乎全军覆没；清军随后在镇南关等地取得胜利，最终签订《中法新约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1884 the Sino-French War broke out. The French fleet attacked the Fujian fleet at Mawei, almost annihilating it; Qing forces later won at Zhennanguan, and the war ended with the Treaty of Tianjin. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷将台湾升格为省，刘铭传任巡抚。
summary.en: The Qing elevated Taiwan to a province, with Liu Mingchuan as governor.

description.zh: 1885 年，清廷在中法战争后决定加强台湾防务，将台湾升格为省，以刘铭传为首任巡抚，推动铁路、电报与新政建设。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1885, after the Sino-French War, the Qing strengthened Taiwan’s defenses and elevated it to a province, appointing Liu Mingchuan as first governor; he promoted railways, telegraphs, and modern reforms. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷颁布《北洋海军章程》，北洋海军正式成军。
summary.en: The Qing promulgated the Beiyang Navy regulations, formally establishing the fleet.

description.zh: 1888 年，清廷颁布《北洋海军章程》，北洋海军正式成军，拥有定远、镇远等铁甲舰，一度号称亚洲第一，但此后军费与训练渐弛。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1888 the Qing promulgated the Beiyang Navy regulations, formally establishing the fleet with the ironclads Dingyuan and Zhenyuan. Briefly rated the strongest in Asia, it later suffered from declining funding and training. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 张之洞创办汉阳铁厂。
summary.en: Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks.

description.zh: 1890 年，张之洞在汉阳创办铁厂，1894 年投产，是当时亚洲最大的钢铁企业之一，后与汉阳兵工厂、湖北织布局构成湖北洋务工业体系。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1890 Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks, which began production in 1894 and became one of Asia’s largest steel enterprises, anchoring Hubei’s Self-Strengthening industrial complex. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 丰岛海战爆发，清军败于日本。
summary.en: The Battle of Pungdo began the First Sino-Japanese War, and the Qing were defeated.

description.zh: 1894 年，日本海军在丰岛海面袭击清军运兵船，甲午战争爆发；清军在海陆战场接连失利，最终签订《马关条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1894 the Japanese navy attacked Qing transports near Pungdo, beginning the First Sino-Japanese War. After defeats on land and sea, the Qing signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 日本舰队在丰岛附近袭击清军运兵船。
summary.en: The Japanese fleet attacked Chinese transports near Fengdao.

description.zh: 1894 年 7 月 25 日，日本联合舰队在朝鲜丰岛附近袭击清军运兵船，击沉高升号，甲午战争由此爆发。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 25 July 1894 the Japanese Combined Fleet attacked Chinese transports near Fengdao off Korea and sank the Kowshing, marking the outbreak of the First Sino-Japanese War. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 日军进攻成欢，清军败退牙山。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Seonghwan and drove the Qing army back to Asan.

description.zh: 1894 年 7 月 29 日，日军进攻驻守朝鲜成欢的清军，清军战败后向牙山方向退却，聂士成等率部突围，甲午陆战由此展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 29 July 1894 Japanese forces attacked the Qing garrison at Seonghwan. After defeat the Qing troops withdrew toward Asan, with Nie Shicheng’s units breaking out, opening the land war of 1894–95. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 清军与日军在平壤激战，清军败退。
summary.en: Qing and Japanese forces fought at Pyongyang, and the Qing army retreated.

description.zh: 1894 年 9 月，清军集结平壤与日军决战，激战一日后败退，退回鸭绿江以北，朝鲜战局急转直下。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1894 Qing forces concentrated at Pyongyang for a decisive battle. After a day of fighting they were defeated and withdrew north of the Yalu, and the war in Korea turned sharply against China. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

name.en: The Battle of the Yellow Sea

summary.zh: 北洋水师与日本联合舰队在黄海激战。
summary.en: The Beiyang Fleet and the Japanese Combined Fleet fought in the Yellow Sea.

description.zh: 1894 年 9 月 17 日，北洋水师护送运兵船返航时在黄海大东沟附近与日本联合舰队遭遇，激战数小时，北洋水师损失多艘军舰，失去黄海制海权。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 17 September 1894 the Beiyang Fleet, escorting transports home, encountered the Japanese Combined Fleet near the Yalu estuary. After hours of fighting the Chinese fleet lost several ships and command of the Yellow Sea. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军突破鸭绿江防线，攻占九连城。
summary.en: Japanese forces broke the Yalu defense line and captured Jiuliancheng.

description.zh: 1894 年 10 月，日军在鸭绿江架桥渡江，进攻九连城与安东，清军防线崩溃，鸭绿江防线失守，日军由此进入辽东。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1894 Japanese forces bridged the Yalu, attacked Jiuliancheng and Andong, and broke the Qing river defense, opening the way into Liaodong. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 日军突破鸭绿江，攻占旅顺。
summary.en: Japanese forces crossed the Yalu and captured Lüshun.

description.zh: 1894 年 10 月起，日军突破鸭绿江防线，接连攻占安东、金州与旅顺，并在旅顺制造大屠杀，北洋海防体系崩溃。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From October 1894 Japanese forces broke through the Yalu defenses and captured Andong, Jinzhou, and Lüshun, carrying out a massacre at Lüshun and collapsing the Beiyang coastal defense system. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 日军攻占威海卫，北洋水师覆没。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Weihaiwei and destroyed the Beiyang Fleet.

description.zh: 1895 年，日军海陆夹攻威海卫，北洋水师困守刘公岛，提督丁汝昌拒降自尽，北洋水师全军覆没。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1895 Japanese land and naval forces attacked Weihaiwei. The Beiyang Fleet, trapped at Liugong Island, was destroyed after Admiral Ding Ruchang refused to surrender and took his own life. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军进攻澎湖，清军抵抗失利。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Penghu and defeated the Qing garrison.

description.zh: 1895 年 3 月，日军进攻澎湖，清军抵抗失利，马公陷落。澎湖失守使清廷在《马关条约》谈判中更为被动。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In March 1895 Japanese forces attacked Penghu. The Qing garrison resisted but was defeated and Magong fell, weakening China’s position in the Shimonoseki negotiations. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 李鸿章与日本签订《马关条约》。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki with Japan.

description.zh: 1895 年 4 月，李鸿章在日本马关与日方签订《马关条约》，割让台湾、澎湖与辽东半岛，赔款二亿两，允许日本在华设厂，震动朝野。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In April 1895 Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki at Shimonoseki, ceding Taiwan, the Penghu Islands, and the Liaodong Peninsula, imposing a 200-million-tael indemnity, and permitting Japanese factories in China, shocking the Qing court and public. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 俄德法干涉，日本归还辽东。
summary.en: Russia, Germany, and France forced Japan to return the Liaodong Peninsula.

description.zh: 1895 年《马关条约》签订后，俄、德、法三国干涉，迫使日本将辽东半岛归还清朝，清廷以额外赔款赎回。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the Treaty of Shimonoseki in 1895, Russia, Germany, and France intervened and forced Japan to return the Liaodong Peninsula to the Qing, which paid an additional indemnity. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The establishment of the Taiwan Governor-General’s Office

summary.zh: 日本在台北设立台湾总督府。
summary.en: Japan established the Governor-General’s Office in Taipei.

description.zh: 1895 年 5 月，日本在台北设立台湾总督府，桦山资纪任首任总督，开始对台湾的殖民统治，与台湾民主国的抵抗同时展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In May 1895 Japan established the Taiwan Governor-General’s Office in Taipei, with Kabayama Sukenori as first governor-general, beginning colonial rule even as the Republic of Formosa resisted. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 台湾士绅宣布成立台湾民主国，抵抗日军。
summary.en: Taiwanese elites proclaimed the Republic of Formosa to resist the Japanese invasion.

description.zh: 1895 年 5 月，台湾士绅与官员在台北宣布成立台湾民主国，年号永清，试图阻止日本接收台湾，随后展开乙未战争，至同年 10 月失败。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In May 1895 Taiwanese elites and officials in Taipei proclaimed the Republic of Formosa, with the era name Yongqing, to resist Japanese annexation. The subsequent Yiwei War ended in defeat by October. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 日军登陆台湾，台湾军民展开乙未战争。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed in Taiwan, beginning the Yiwei War of resistance.

description.zh: 1895 年 5 月 29 日，日军在澳底登陆，台湾军民展开乙未战争，历经台北、新竹、苗栗、彰化、台南等战，至 10 月台南陷落而告终。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 29 May 1895 Japanese forces landed at Aodi, beginning the Yiwei War. Taiwanese and Qing forces fought through Taipei, Hsinchu, Miaoli, Changhua, and Tainan until the fall of Tainan in October. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 日军进攻新竹，台湾义军与黑旗军抵抗。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Hsinchu; Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army resisted.

description.zh: 1895 年 7 月，日军进攻新竹，台湾义军与黑旗军据城抵抗，激战后新竹失守，日军继续向南推进。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In July 1895 Japanese forces attacked Hsinchu. Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army defended the town, but it fell after heavy fighting and the Japanese advanced southward. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 日军在三角涌遭台湾义军伏击。
summary.en: Japanese forces were ambushed by Taiwanese militia at Sanxia.

description.zh: 1895 年 7 月，日军在三角涌（今三峡）一带遭台湾义军伏击，伤亡较重，随后调集援军反攻，三角涌一带成为乙未战争的重要战场。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In July 1895 Japanese forces were ambushed by Taiwanese militia near Sanxia (then Sanshiayong), suffering notable casualties before reinforcements counterattacked. The area became an important battlefield of the Yiwei War. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 张之洞奏设湖北枪炮厂。
summary.en: Zhang Zhidong established the Hubei Arsenal.

description.zh: 1895 年，张之洞在汉阳奏设湖北枪炮厂，引进德国机器制造枪炮，后称汉阳兵工厂，其“汉阳造”步枪长期装备中国军队。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1895 Zhang Zhidong established the Hubei Arsenal at Hanyang with German machinery to produce rifles and artillery. Later known as the Hanyang Arsenal, its “Hanyang” rifle equipped Chinese armies for decades. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 日军进攻苗栗，义军抵抗后撤退。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Miaoli; the militia resisted and withdrew.

description.zh: 1895 年 8 月，日军进攻苗栗，台湾义军与黑旗军抵抗后撤退，苗栗失守，日军逼近大甲溪。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1895 Japanese forces attacked Miaoli. Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army resisted before withdrawing, Miaoli fell, and the Japanese approached the Dajia River. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

name.en: The Battle of the Dajia River

summary.zh: 日军渡大甲溪，义军阻击失利。
summary.en: Japanese forces crossed the Dajia River after defeating the militia.

description.zh: 1895 年 8 月，日军渡大甲溪进攻台中，台湾义军与黑旗军依托河岸阻击，最终失利，台中门户洞开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1895 Japanese forces crossed the Dajia River toward Taichung. Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army defended the riverbank but were defeated, opening the route to Taichung. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 日军进攻八卦山，台湾义军与黑旗军激战。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Bagua Mountain; Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army fought back.

description.zh: 1895 年 8 月，日军进攻彰化八卦山，台湾义军与黑旗军据险抵抗，激战后彰化失守，吴汤兴、徐骧等阵亡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1895 Japanese forces attacked Bagua Mountain at Changhua. Taiwanese militia and the Black Flag Army resisted from strong positions, but Changhua fell after heavy fighting and leaders such as Wu Tangxing and Xu Xiang were killed. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 日军攻占台南，乙未战争结束。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Tainan, ending the Yiwei War.

description.zh: 1895 年 10 月，日军进攻台南，刘永福内渡，台湾民主国灭亡，乙未战争结束，台湾进入日本殖民统治时期。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1895 Japanese forces took Tainan. Liu Yongfu fled to the mainland, the Republic of Formosa collapsed, and the Yiwei War ended, beginning the period of Japanese colonial rule in Taiwan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷以赎金换回辽东半岛。
summary.en: The Qing redeemed the Liaodong Peninsula with an indemnity.

description.zh: 1895 年 11 月，中日签订《辽南条约》，清廷以三千万两白银赎回辽东半岛，日军撤出旅顺、大连，三国干涉还辽至此落地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1895 China and Japan signed the Treaty of Liaonan. The Qing paid a 30-million-tael indemnity to redeem the Liaodong Peninsula, and Japanese forces withdrew from Lüshun and Dalian, concluding the Triple Intervention settlement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清军接收旅顺，处理善后与海防重建。
summary.en: Qing forces recovered Lüshun and began postwar reconstruction.

description.zh: 1895 年 12 月，清军接收旅顺，处理日军撤离后的善后事宜，重建海防与地方秩序，但北洋海防已难以恢复旧观。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In December 1895 Qing forces recovered Lüshun and handled postwar matters after the Japanese withdrawal, rebuilding coastal defense and local order, though the Beiyang defense system never regained its former strength. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 简大狮在台北一带起事抗日。
summary.en: Jian Dashi rose against the Japanese in the Taipei area.

description.zh: 1895 年底，简大狮在台北一带起事抗日，袭击日军据点，后转战台湾北部，最终失败并内渡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: At the end of 1895 Jian Dashi rose against Japanese rule in the Taipei area, attacking Japanese posts and later moving across northern Taiwan before his ultimate defeat and return to the mainland. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》

sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 台北芝山岩的日本教师遭袭击，日方展开报复。
summary.en: Japanese teachers at Zhishanyan were attacked, prompting reprisals.

description.zh: 1896 年 1 月，台北士林芝山岩的日本小学教师遭抗日民众袭击，多人死亡，日方随后展开报复性扫荡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In January 1896 Japanese schoolteachers at Zhishanyan in Shilin, Taipei, were attacked by anti-Japanese locals, and several were killed. Japanese forces responded with reprisal sweeps. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 日军在云林进行报复性扫荡。
summary.en: Japanese forces carried out reprisal sweeps in Yunlin.

description.zh: 1896 年 6 月，日军在云林一带进行报复性扫荡，造成大量平民死亡，史称云林事件（云林大屠杀）。具体死亡人数仍有争议，本文只记事件性质。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In June 1896 Japanese forces carried out reprisal sweeps in the Yunlin area, causing heavy civilian deaths, an event known as the Yunlin incident (or Yunlin massacre). Casualty figures remain disputed; this entry records only the nature of the event. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 柯铁虎等据铁国山坚持抗日游击。
summary.en: Ke Tiehu and others based their resistance at Tieguoshan.

description.zh: 1896 年，柯铁虎等人在云林古坑铁国山建立抗日据点，坚持游击战，多次击退日军围剿，成为台湾中部抗日的重要力量。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1896 Ke Tiehu and other fighters established a resistance base at Tieguoshan in Gukeng, Yunlin, waging guerrilla warfare and repelling repeated Japanese sweeps, becoming a major force in central Taiwan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 德国租借胶州湾，列强掀起瓜分狂潮。
summary.en: Germany leased Jiaozhou Bay, setting off a scramble for concessions.

description.zh: 1898 年，德国强迫清廷租借胶州湾，俄、英、法、日等国随后纷纷租借港湾、划分势力范围，中国面临被瓜分的危机。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1898 Germany forced the Qing to lease Jiaozhou Bay. Russia, Britain, France, and Japan soon leased ports and carved out spheres of influence, confronting China with the threat of partition. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 光绪帝下诏变法，百日维新开始。
summary.en: The Guangxu Emperor issued reform edicts, beginning the Hundred Days’ Reform.

description.zh: 1898 年 6 月 11 日，光绪帝颁布“明定国是”诏书，开始变法；9 月慈禧太后发动政变，变法失败，史称戊戌变法或百日维新。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 11 June 1898 the Guangxu Emperor issued the reform edict, beginning the Hundred Days’ Reform. In September the Empress Dowager Cixi staged a coup and ended the reforms. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 林少猫在阿猴一带组织抗日。
summary.en: Lin Shaomao organized resistance around Akau (Pingtung).

description.zh: 1898 年，林少猫在阿猴（今屏东）一带组织抗日，控制地方并袭击日军，后与日方谈判，1902 年失败。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1898 Lin Shaomao organized resistance around Akau (modern Pingtung), controlling local areas and attacking Japanese forces. He later negotiated with the Japanese and was defeated in 1902. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

name.en: The Boxer Uprising and the Eight-Nation Alliance

summary.zh: 义和团进入北京，八国联军侵华。
summary.en: The Boxers entered Beijing and the Eight-Nation Alliance intervened.

description.zh: 1900 年，义和团运动高涨并进入北京，清廷对列强宣战；八国联军攻占北京，慈禧太后西逃，次年签订《辛丑条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1900 the Boxer movement spread to Beijing and the Qing court declared war on the powers. The Eight-Nation Alliance captured Beijing, the court fled west, and the Boxer Protocol was signed in 1901. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The Mutual Protection of Southeast China

summary.zh: 东南督抚与列强达成互保协议。
summary.en: Southeast governors and foreign powers agreed to mutual protection.

description.zh: 1900 年义和团运动期间，刘坤一、张之洞等东南督抚与列强驻沪领事达成“东南互保”协议，避免战火波及东南各省，显示清廷中央权威的衰落。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: During the Boxer crisis of 1900, governors Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong reached a “mutual protection” agreement with foreign consuls in Shanghai, keeping the war out of southeastern provinces and revealing the decline of central authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷推行新政，废科举、练新军。
summary.en: The Qing launched the New Policies, abolishing the civil service exams and creating a modern army.

description.zh: 1901 年起，清廷推行新政，包括改革官制、废科举、练新军、兴学堂等，试图挽救统治危机，但未能阻止革命。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From 1901 the Qing implemented the New Policies, reforming the bureaucracy, abolishing the civil service examinations, creating a modern army, and founding schools. The reforms failed to prevent revolution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The abolition of the imperial examinations

summary.zh: 清廷诏废科举，千年科举制终结。
summary.en: The Qing abolished the imperial examinations after a millennium.

description.zh: 1905 年 9 月，清廷诏令自 1906 年起停止科举，延续千年的科举制度终结，新式学堂成为主要上升通道。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1905 the Qing court ordered the imperial examinations stopped from 1906, ending a system that had lasted a millennium and making modern schools the main path to advancement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

name.zh: 上海城厢内外总工程局

summary.zh: 上海绅商成立城厢内外总工程局。
summary.en: Shanghai elites founded the General Works Bureau.

description.zh: 1905 年 10 月，上海地方绅商成立城厢内外总工程局，办理市政、警务与公益，是清末地方自治的重要实践。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1905 Shanghai elites founded the General Works Bureau for the city’s inner and outer districts, handling municipal administration, policing, and public welfare—an important experiment in late Qing local self-government. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 清廷派五大臣出洋考察宪政。
summary.en: The Qing sent five ministers abroad to study constitutional government.

description.zh: 1905 年 12 月，清廷派载泽、端方等五大臣出洋考察宪政，为预备立宪做准备，回国后推动了 1906 年的预备立宪诏。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In December 1905 the Qing sent ministers including Zaitze and Duanfang abroad to study constitutional government, preparing for the 1906 announcement of preparations for a constitution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 袁世凯在天津试办地方自治。
summary.en: Yuan Shikai experimented with local self-government in Tianjin.

description.zh: 1906 年，袁世凯在天津试办地方自治，设立天津自治局，推行议事会与董事会，成为清末地方自治的样板。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1906 Yuan Shikai experimented with local self-government in Tianjin, establishing the Tianjin Self-Government Bureau with councils and boards, a model for late Qing local autonomy. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 清廷宣布预备立宪。
summary.en: The Qing court announced preparations for constitutional government.

description.zh: 1906 年，清廷在五大臣出洋考察后宣布“预备仿行宪政”，推行官制改革，但进展缓慢，未能挽回人心。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1906, after the five ministers’ overseas investigations, the Qing court announced preparations for constitutional government and reformed the bureaucracy, but progress was slow and failed to restore public confidence. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》。
summary.en: The Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution.

description.zh: 1908 年，清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》，规定君上大权，并以九年为预备立宪期限，被立宪派批评为“假立宪”。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1908 the Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution, preserving broad imperial powers and setting a nine-year preparatory period. Constitutionalists criticized it as “fake constitutionalism.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 清廷颁布城镇乡地方自治章程。
summary.en: The Qing promulgated regulations on urban and rural local self-government.

description.zh: 1909 年 1 月，清廷颁布《城镇乡地方自治章程》，推行地方自治，设立议事会与董事会，为立宪派参与地方政治提供制度空间。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In January 1909 the Qing promulgated regulations on local self-government in towns and villages, establishing councils and boards and giving constitutionalists an institutional foothold in local politics. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 清廷令各省设立自治研究所。
summary.en: The Qing ordered provinces to establish self-government institutes.

description.zh: 1909 年，清廷令各省设立自治研究所，培养地方自治人才，为城镇乡自治的推行做准备。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1909 the Qing ordered provinces to establish self-government institutes to train local personnel for implementing urban and rural self-government. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 各省咨议局成立，立宪派进入地方政治。
summary.en: Provincial assemblies were established, bringing constitutionalists into local politics.

description.zh: 1909 年，清廷在各省设立咨议局，作为地方议事机构，立宪派借此扩大政治影响，推动召开国会请愿运动。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1909 the Qing established provincial assemblies as local deliberative bodies. Constitutionalists used them to expand political influence and press for a national parliament. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The petition movement for a parliament

summary.zh: 各省代表赴京请愿，要求速开国会。
summary.en: Provincial delegates petitioned Beijing for an early national parliament.

description.zh: 1910 年，各省咨议局与商会、教育会等团体发起三次国会请愿运动，要求缩短预备立宪期限、速开国会，清廷仅小幅让步，立宪派日益失望。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1910 provincial assemblies, chambers of commerce, and educational associations launched three petition campaigns demanding that the Qing shorten the preparatory period and convene a parliament. The court made only minor concessions, and constitutionalists grew increasingly disillusioned. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

summary.zh: 各省咨议局代表在北京成立联合会。
summary.en: Delegates from provincial assemblies formed a federation in Beijing.

description.zh: 1910 年 8 月，各省咨议局代表在北京成立联合会，协调请愿速开国会与立宪事宜，成为立宪派跨省联合的重要平台。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1910 delegates from provincial assemblies formed a federation in Beijing to coordinate petitions for an early parliament and constitutional government, creating an important cross-provincial platform for constitutionalists. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

name.en: The election of the Advisory Council

summary.zh: 资政院议员选举后开院，立宪派进入中央议事机构。
summary.en: After elections, the Advisory Council opened, bringing constitutionalists into a central deliberative body.

description.zh: 1909 年各省选举资政院议员，1910 年 10 月资政院开院，成为清末立宪派参与中央政治的重要平台，但权限有限，未能满足速开国会的要求。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1909 the provinces elected members of the Advisory Council, which opened in October 1910 as a central deliberative body for constitutionalists. Its powers were limited, however, and it failed to satisfy demands for a parliament. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《甲午战争史》
sources.author: 戚其章
sources.note: 甲午战争战役与人物参考

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

name.en: The Advisory Council impeaches the Grand Council

summary.zh: 资政院弹劾军机大臣，要求责任内阁。
summary.en: The Advisory Council impeached the Grand Council and demanded a responsible cabinet.

description.zh: 1910 年 12 月，资政院第一次常年会弹劾军机大臣，要求设立责任内阁，与清廷发生正面冲突，显示资政院与皇权的张力。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In December 1910 the Advisory Council’s first annual session impeached the Grand Council and demanded a responsible cabinet, clashing directly with the court and revealing the tension between the council and imperial authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 清廷成立皇族主导的内阁，立宪派失望。
summary.en: The Qing formed a cabinet dominated by imperial kinsmen, disappointing constitutionalists.

description.zh: 1911 年 5 月，清廷成立新内阁，13 名阁员中皇族占 7 人，被称为“皇族内阁”，立宪派大失所望，进一步转向革命。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In May 1911 the Qing formed a new cabinet with seven of thirteen members from the imperial clan. Dubbed the “Royal Cabinet,” it deeply disappointed constitutionalists and pushed many toward revolution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 四川保路运动爆发，成为辛亥革命导火索。
summary.en: The Sichuan Railway Protection Movement erupted, helping trigger the 1911 Revolution.

description.zh: 1911 年，清廷宣布铁路国有，激起四川保路运动，清廷调湖北新军入川镇压，削弱了武汉防务，为武昌起义创造了条件。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1911 the Qing move to nationalize railways sparked the Sichuan Railway Protection Movement. Troops were drawn from Hubei to suppress it, weakening Wuhan’s defenses and creating conditions for the Wuchang Uprising. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 立宪派在北京成立宪友会。
summary.en: Constitutionalists founded the Xianyouhui in Beijing.

description.zh: 1911 年 6 月，宪友会在北京成立，试图整合立宪派力量，推动宪政，但清廷随即成立皇族内阁，立宪派进一步失望。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In June 1911 the Xianyouhui was founded in Beijing to unite constitutionalist forces and promote constitutional government. The court’s formation of the Royal Cabinet soon afterward deepened their disillusionment. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 武昌起义爆发，各省响应。
summary.en: The Wuchang Uprising broke out and provinces across China responded.

description.zh: 1911 年 10 月 10 日，新军在武昌起义，攻占湖广总督署，各省随后纷纷响应，清朝统治迅速瓦解。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 10 October 1911, New Army units rose in Wuchang and seized the Hubei governor’s office. Provinces across China soon responded, and Qing rule rapidly collapsed. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《明史》
sources.author: 张廷玉等
sources.note: 明代事件与人物参考，路线为示意简化

summary.zh: 革命军与清军在汉口激战。
summary.en: Revolutionary and Qing forces fought for Hankou.

description.zh: 1911 年 10 月，革命军与清军在汉口激战，冯国璋率北洋军进攻，汉口一度失守，战火波及租界。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1911 revolutionary and Qing forces fought bitterly for Hankou. Feng Guozhang’s Beiyang troops attacked, the city briefly fell, and the fighting spread to the foreign concessions. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 湖南革命党人与新军起义，攻占长沙。
summary.en: Hunan revolutionaries and the New Army rose and took Changsha.

description.zh: 1911 年 10 月 22 日，湖南革命党人与新军起义，攻占长沙，成立湖南军政府，焦达峰、陈作新任正副都督。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 22 October 1911 Hunan revolutionaries and New Army units rose, captured Changsha, and established the Hunan military government with Jiao Dafeng and Chen Zuoxin as governors. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 辛亥革命与各省光复参考

summary.zh: 陕西新军起义，攻占西安。
summary.en: Shaanxi’s New Army rose and took Xi’an.

description.zh: 1911 年 10 月 22 日，陕西新军起义，攻占西安，成立秦陇复汉军政府，张凤翙任大统领。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 22 October 1911 Shaanxi’s New Army rose, captured Xi’an, and established the Qinlong revolutionary military government under Zhang Fenghui. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 辛亥革命与各省光复参考

summary.zh: 新军第二十镇在滦州发动兵谏。
summary.en: The 20th Division staged a remonstrance at Luanzhou.

description.zh: 1911 年 10 月，新军第二十镇在滦州发动兵谏，要求清廷速行立宪、组织责任内阁，与武昌起义后的政治危机相互激荡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1911 the 20th Division staged a remonstrance at Luanzhou, demanding immediate constitutional government and a responsible cabinet, interacting with the political crisis after the Wuchang uprising. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 山西新军起义，攻占太原。
summary.en: Shanxi’s New Army rose and took Taiyuan.

description.zh: 1911 年 10 月 29 日，山西新军起义，攻占太原，成立山西军政府，阎锡山任都督。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 29 October 1911 Shanxi’s New Army rose, captured Taiyuan, and established the Shanxi military government with Yan Xishan as governor. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Double Ninth uprising in Kunming

summary.zh: 云南新军重九起义，攻占昆明。
summary.en: Yunnan’s New Army rose on the Double Ninth festival and took Kunming.

description.zh: 1911 年 10 月 30 日（农历九月初九），云南新军起义，攻占昆明，成立云南军政府，蔡锷任都督。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 30 October 1911, the Double Ninth festival, Yunnan’s New Army rose, captured Kunming, and established the Yunnan military government with Cai E as governor. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 江西新军起义，攻占南昌。
summary.en: Jiangxi’s New Army rose and took Nanchang.

description.zh: 1911 年 10 月底，江西新军起义，攻占南昌，成立江西军政府，李烈钧等参与。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: At the end of October 1911 Jiangxi’s New Army rose, captured Nanchang, and established the Jiangxi military government, with figures such as Li Liejun involved. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 辛亥革命与各省光复参考

summary.zh: 清廷颁布《宪法重大信条十九条》。
summary.en: The Qing court issued the Nineteen Articles.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月，清廷颁布《宪法重大信条十九条》，承认君主立宪、限制君权，试图挽回立宪派，但为时已晚。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1911 the Qing court issued the Nineteen Articles, accepting constitutional monarchy and limiting imperial power in an attempt to win back constitutionalists, but too late. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 上海革命党人与商团起义，攻占制造总局。
summary.en: Shanghai revolutionaries and militia rose and seized the Arsenal.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月 3 日，上海革命党人与商团起义，攻占江南制造总局，成立沪军都督府，陈其美任都督。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 3 November 1911 Shanghai revolutionaries and militia rose, seized the Jiangnan Arsenal, and established the Shanghai military government under Chen Qimei. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 辛亥革命与各省光复参考

summary.zh: 浙江革命党人与新军起义，攻占杭州。
summary.en: Zhejiang revolutionaries and the New Army rose and took Hangzhou.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月 4 日，浙江革命党人与新军起义，攻占杭州，成立浙江军政府，汤寿潜任都督。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 4 November 1911 Zhejiang revolutionaries and New Army units rose, captured Hangzhou, and established the Zhejiang military government with Tang Shouqian as governor. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 江苏巡抚程德全宣布独立，苏州光复。
summary.en: Governor Cheng Dequan declared independence and Suzhou was recovered.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月 5 日，江苏巡抚程德全宣布独立，苏州光复，成立江苏军政府。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 5 November 1911 Jiangsu governor Cheng Dequan declared independence, Suzhou was recovered, and the Jiangsu military government was established. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 福建革命党人与新军起义，攻占福州。
summary.en: Fujian revolutionaries and the New Army rose and took Fuzhou.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月 9 日，福建革命党人与新军起义，攻占福州，成立福建军政府，孙道仁任都督。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 9 November 1911 Fujian revolutionaries and New Army units rose, captured Fuzhou, and established the Fujian military government with Sun Daoren as governor. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.author: 章开沅等
sources.note: 辛亥革命与各省光复参考

summary.zh: 广东各界宣布独立，广州光复。
summary.en: Guangdong notables declared independence and Guangzhou was recovered.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月 9 日，广东各界宣布独立，广州光复，成立广东军政府，胡汉民任都督。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 9 November 1911 Guangdong notables declared independence, Guangzhou was recovered, and the Guangdong military government was established with Hu Hanmin as governor. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《辛亥革命史》
sources.author: 章开沅等
sources.note: 辛亥革命与各省光复参考

summary.zh: 黄兴率革命军在汉阳与北洋军激战。
summary.en: Huang Xing’s revolutionary forces fought the Beiyang army at Hanyang.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月，黄兴率革命军在汉阳与北洋军激战，最终失利，革命军退守武昌，武汉战局转入僵持。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1911 Huang Xing led revolutionary forces in a fierce battle against the Beiyang army at Hanyang. After defeat the revolutionaries withdrew to Wuchang, and the Wuhan front settled into stalemate. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 四川军政府在成都成立，宣布独立。
summary.en: The Sichuan military government was established in Chengdu and declared independence.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月 27 日，四川军政府在成都成立，宣布独立，赵尔丰政权结束，四川保路运动转入革命阶段。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 27 November 1911 the Sichuan military government was established in Chengdu and declared independence, ending Zhao Erfeng’s administration and turning the railway-protection movement into revolution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 辛亥革命与各省光复参考

summary.zh: 江浙联军攻克南京。
summary.en: The Jiangsu–Zhejiang allied forces captured Nanjing.

description.zh: 1911 年 11 月至 12 月，江浙联军进攻南京，12 月 2 日攻克南京，为中华民国临时政府定都南京奠定基础。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From November to December 1911 the Jiangsu–Zhejiang allied forces attacked Nanjing and captured it on 2 December, paving the way for the Provisional Government of the Republic of China to choose Nanjing as its capital. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《辛亥革命史》
sources.author: 章开沅等
sources.note: 辛亥革命与各省光复参考

summary.zh: 南北双方在上海开始议和。
summary.en: North and south began peace talks in Shanghai.

description.zh: 1911 年 12 月，清廷与南方革命政权在上海开始议和，讨论停战、政体与清帝退位安排，为 1912 年清帝退位铺路。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In December 1911 the Qing court and the southern revolutionary government opened peace talks in Shanghai on a ceasefire, the form of government, and the abdication of the Qing emperor, paving the way for the 1912 abdication. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《台湾通史》
sources.author: 连横
sources.note: 台湾乙未战争与地方史参考

summary.zh: 隆裕太后颁布退位诏书，清朝灭亡。
summary.en: Empress Dowager Longyu issued the abdication edict, ending the Qing dynasty.

description.zh: 1912 年 2 月 12 日，隆裕太后以宣统帝名义颁布退位诏书，清朝灭亡，中国两千多年的帝制结束。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On 12 February 1912, Empress Dowager Longyu issued the abdication edict in the name of the Xuantong Emperor, ending the Qing dynasty and more than two millennia of imperial rule in China. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
